description: AC-15 (OM-I05) templates. Every secret-shaped value is a `{{slot}}` placeholder, filled from a seed at test time (`render(seed)`) and never committed: the file parses as it stands and holds nothing a scanner reads as a credential. The inputs are an error text that echoes `X-BAPI-API-KEY`, `X-BAPI-SIGN`, the timestamp and receive-window headers (create); one that echoes a signed URL (cancel); one that echoes a letters-only key (amend); a refused `auth` reply that echoes the `auth` frame and the key in its message and a connection id; and an execution push with a letters-only key and a symbol-shaped key under two fields of its row the redactor does not know.

echo_headers.json.derivation: The transcribed `110072` row with its message text followed by an echo of four request headers, three of them placeholders and the receive window 5000. The code is unchanged.

echo_url.json.derivation: The transcribed `110001` row with its message text followed by a signed URL whose key, timestamp and signature are placeholders. The code is unchanged.

echo_letters.json.derivation: The transcribed `110001` row with its message text followed by a placeholder letters-only key. The code is unchanged.

frames.jsonl.derivation: Line 1: the transcribed `auth` reply with `success` false, its message an echo of a key, a signature and an `auth` frame (all placeholders) and a letters-only key, and its connection id a placeholder. Line 2: the transcribed execution push with two values changed, `blockTradeId` a placeholder letters-only key and `tradeIv` a placeholder symbol-shaped key. No key is added or dropped.

expected: None of the inputs appears in `order_events`, `include_events`, diagnostics, audit rows or logs; a key-shaped token the exchange echoes is masked by the store, and a masked echo still reads as the row it is (AC-15, OM-I05).
